opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: up to £56,000 in year one, £28,000 in years two and three, plus up to £6,000 per annum for research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers who have not yet held a full‑time permanent academic post in the UK; must hold a doctorate; must have submitted doctoral thesis for viva by the closing date; UK residency requirements; cannot have held certain postdoctoral fellowships.
opportunities.summary: Supports early‑career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable research over a three‑year period.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under 18s

amount.raw: Maximum total award of £475,000 (plus a 5% contribution to administration).

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities delivering outstanding teaching; institutions only (no individuals); one application per round; non‑specialist arts schools and universities ineligible.
opportunities.summary: Funds arts training for school‑age children (under 18) outside regular school hours, supporting outreach and weekend/holiday programmes.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under/Postgraduate

amount.raw: Maximum total award of £475,000 (plus 5% administrative contribution); bursaries of £5,000‑£10,000 per student per year.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or charities offering undergraduate/postgraduate degrees; institutions only; one application per round; university departments not eligible; supports bursaries for outstanding students.
opportunities.summary: Provides bursaries to support undergraduate and postgraduate students in fine and performing arts who lack financial means.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Retired or partially retired senior researchers who have held a UK university teaching/research post; must live in the UK ≥26 weeks per year; must have an established research record; institutional approval required.
opportunities.summary: Supports senior researchers to complete or integrate a research project and prepare results for publication.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships (Centenary)

amount.raw: Ten awards of up to £5 million each, providing funds for 18 doctoral scholarships (UK rates) and 6 international scholarships.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities with research degree‑awarding powers (or consortia of up to two such universities); applications made by a lead university; not open to individual applicants.
opportunities.summary: Provides large‑scale funding to establish interdisciplinary doctoral scholarship programmes, including support for under‑represented groups and post‑doctoral opportunities.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million for up to 10 years.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities with research degree‑awarding powers (including Oxford, Cambridge, Imperial for this round); single or collaborative centres; one application per lead university.
opportunities.summary: Funds the establishment of research centres that aim for a step‑change in scholarship across any discipline.

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Salary costs (starting at junior lecturer scale) plus up to £6,000 per year for research expenses.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Well‑established researchers in humanities or social sciences employed at a UK university with research degree‑awarding powers; cannot be previous holders of a Major Research Fellowship.
opportunities.summary: Provides salary support for distinguished researchers to complete a piece of original research over two or three years.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications

amount.raw: Maximum grant value £500,000; projects may run up to five years.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities and other UK higher‑education institutions (and, on a trial basis, UK‑based independent research institutes); principal investigator must be employed by the institution; up to three co‑applicants allowed.
opportunities.summary: Funds innovative, original research projects across all eligible disciplines, covering staff costs, consumables, travel, and related expenses.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK university academic staff (or specialist arts institutions) who will host an eminent overseas professor; host institution must have research degree‑awarding powers; visitor must be senior professor from overseas.
opportunities.summary: Supports visits of eminent overseas scholars to UK institutions to provide novel expertise, deliver lectures, and enhance skills of staff and students.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards

amount.raw: Up to £1 million for staff salaries and associated costs.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career scholars with at least two years post‑PhD experience, holding a permanent UK academic appointment (or nominated with contract offer); must not have led a research team or held comparable awards; one bid per institution.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding for early‑career researchers to build and lead a modest research team, developing research leadership and delivering impactful research.
